course.title: Computer Graphics and Image Processing

content.value: Consider the following 5×5 image with grayscale range of [0, 9].
i) Plotthe histogram of the image.
ii) Perform histogram equalization and then show the equalized image and plot histogram again.
iii) Histogram matching is a useful contrast manipulation technique that transforms an image's histogram to match with that of another image. Clearly describe how can you achieve it.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
